capabilities: Set note font size via a font-size frontmatter property
Adjust font size with a slider in the view header
Show the current font size in the status bar
Configure minimum, maximum, and default font sizes
Animate font size changes with CSS transitions
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation instructions cover development setup (npm build) rather than a community plugins download.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to set the text size of individual notes; font size is a global setting or manual CSS snippet work.
summary: Per-note font size control that reads a font-size frontmatter property and offers a slider and status bar indicator to adjust it.
